grammar.title: 将来时态的表达
grammar.explanation: 英语表达将来有多种方式：will/shall + do（即时决定/预测）；be going to + do（计划/迹象）；be to + do（安排）；be about to + do（即将）。
grammar.structure: will do / be going to do / be to do / be about to do

grammar.ieltsTip: 雅思口语Part 2描述未来计划时，准确使用将来时态表达能让语言更地道。

speaking.cueCard: Describe a goal you set and worked hard to achieve. You should say: what the goal was / why you set it / how you achieved it / and explain how you felt when you achieved it.
speaking.sampleAnswer: A goal that required tremendous effort was running a half marathon, which I set my sights on two years ago after years of being decidedly unfit. I chose this goal because I wanted to prove to myself that I could commit to something demanding and see it through. The training spanned six months, during which I gradually increased my weekly mileage, joined a running club for accountability, and overhauled my diet to support my physical exertion. There were moments of doubt, especially during cold winter mornings when the temptation to skip training was overwhelming. When I finally crossed the finish line, the sense of accomplishment was indescribable—part exhilaration, part relief, and a profound realization that discipline and perseverance can transform seemingly impossible aspirations into reality.
speaking.tips: 描述目标时强调努力过程，体现意志力。
